description: This file contains unit tests for the GstProtectionMetadataWrapper class, testing its methods for adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata from GstBuffer objects. It uses Google Test framework and mocks GstWrapper interactions.

classes.name: RialtoProtectionMetadataTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing GstProtectionMetadataWrapper functionalities.

methods.description: Tests adding protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.description: Tests retrieval when no protection metadata is present in the GstBuffer.

methods.description: Tests successful removal of protection metadata from a GstBuffer.
